metadata.evidence: This new model merges and harmonizes two or more different and non-interoperable music representations (e.g. audio data and scores), either symbolic or non-symbolic. This approach has multiple advantages: by connecting different MSRs, it will be possible to exploit all the characteristics that such representations can provide. Secondly, this novel representation attempts to solve some of the problems that affect contemporary musicology.
metadata.reason: Defines the ontology's central interoperability function.
